title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.67 release candidate adds 245 revision-pinned Qwen2 1.5B Instruct BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 72,322 valid samples, 630 probe cells, 215 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
